requirement: Serve lower-budget recording studios including studios with substantial audio hardware; support any finite total project track count admitted by configured resources without a fixed product/license ceiling.

acceptance_workflows.workflow: Create/edit/group/Undo/Redo/Save/reopen257,512,1024,4096-track synthetic projects preserving all stable IDs/routes/state; no replacement fixed product ceiling.
Admit/refuse under declared state/memory/IO budgets before mutation; untrusted projects cannot raise trusted admission budgets. Safe old-version refusal and no truncation.
Bounded media cache/open handles, virtualized UI/meters and measured snapshots/history under sparse large project workloads; missing media/autosave/recovery retained.
Prepared serial/parallel/offline graphs preserve processing quality, events, buses/sidechains/PDC/tails and safe retirement with zero RT allocations/frees/blocking locks.
Freeze/unfreeze/bounce restores originals/plugin state and timing; cancel/failure never silently discards source tracks.
Modest/strong Linux and Windows profiles record total/active/recording track counts, effects, rate/quantum, memory/IO and sustained current-cycle deadlines; explicit overload/recovery.
